newsitem.title: JAPAN: Moody's to monitor NCB restructuring.
newsitem.headline: Moody's to monitor NCB restructuring.

text.p: Moody's Investors Service said on Wednesday it would monitor Nippon Credit Bank Ltd's restructuring to decide its rating direction.
"Moody's is particularly concerned about the ability of NCB to obtain funding at a price comparable to that of other domestic debenture-issuing banks," Moody's said in a statement.
Moody's currently rates NCB's senior debt at Ba1 and has given it a deposit rating of Baa3/P-3 and a financial strength rating of E.
It said about 10 trillion yen of long-term debt was affected.

NCB, the smallest of Japan's three long-term credit banks, announced on Tuesday that it will restructure, halting overseas operations, selling off its Tokyo headquarters and posting losses to dispose of problem loans.
